name: 黑底缩圈与采访漫画

readiness.scope: 当前可查看并复用基础机制；精细版仍在制作，不能作为逐帧或原配色完整验收。

source.author: 兔兔不熬夜（剪辑师版）
source.title: 口播网感开场如何设计最好？

semantic_use: 从全画面收缩到脸部，引导注意力。
observed_motion: 人物被圆形蒙版保留，外侧黑底与虚线圈突出边界，上弧标题标出蒙版缩圈。

basic_implementation.scope: 蒙版与裁切动画，圆心必须跟随人物脸部。
basic_implementation.parameter_scope: Listed parameters are runtime spec fields. Design variables such as band ratios, path coordinates and entry timing remain authored engine defaults and require a project-specific code adaptation; not an arbitrary automatic inverse-effects system.
basic_implementation.preview_limit: Early four-second mechanism and alternate-content samples are simplified; they do not establish native fidelity or arbitrary filmed-foreground reuse.

presenter_rules.opening: 本人画面承担开头与立场
presenter_rules.returns: 按重要观点、情绪转折和收尾回到人物，不机械每N秒，不只出现一次。
presenter_rules.fit: 匹配本人的取景、脸部占窗和真实上半身，不能扩展不存在的人体像素。
presenter_rules.alpha: 需前景人物效果时用与实际母片时间一致的动态alpha，不能用静态抠像替代移动人物。

adaptation.new_clip_reference: New reference/reference-native specs bind the accepted user master and its native window/SHA/PTS. Learned tutorial provenance stays in this recipe. Reusing an existing recipe does not require redownloading/restudying its tutorial.
adaptation.trigger: 根据当前口播真实词轴触发，保持选定配色/文字体系/层次/动作顺序。
adaptation.missing_measurement: 原字体、原工程和未覆盖分支如实标记；授权替代字体重排后检查当前文案。

validation.basic_mechanism_preview: Original 30 source entries and28 modules each have actual primary/replacement-content preview records in assets/social-grammars/validation.json.

font.source_family: unknown from compressed reference; fixed isolated glyph study only
font.editable_fallback: NotoSansSC/available system font, approximate shape must be separately reviewed

grammar.event_policy: real measured source events; cut/pulse/path ordering preserved, new narration must align to accepted word clock

replacement_limits.fixed_source_glyphs: not editable; new phrase requires approximate font or separately identified licensed original font
replacement_limits.timing: reuse native enter/hold/exit proportions, map to new word/semantic clock with no claim of exact same phrase animation
replacement_limits.subject: different footage must be reframed and reviewed rather than copied old face coordinates
replacement_limits.ring: private measured visible capsules follow source head occlusion. Editable full ring parameters: native8px roundcaps,15pxstraight,41pxperiod; hidden phase approximate.

unresolved: Different genuine stock presenter, face/gestures/room; no original actor replay. Silent technical animation reconstruction, no voice/lip-sync claim.
Original font/project unknown. Private original fixed glyph art cannot be advertised as arbitrary editable original font.
Source native H264 compression and new H264 codec colors/antialiasing differ; no100% pixel claim.
Original keyboard/finger B-roll is replaced with genuine blurred stock; rebuilt plant-only circle scenery is independent and not recovered original room.
Partially clipped circle entrance F500/501 and border hidden behind source hair are measured/estimated; dashed phase and hidden arcs are reconstructed, not100% recovered.
Foreground head is deliberately separate RVM to overlap pink ring, hair/torso contour differs; stock provides chest, no original hand-number gesture is invented.

Interview art and original curved font are private fixed sprite study only. Sticker region y>=780 excludes actor, source anti-aliasing on black is private fixed artwork; editable illustrator variant would need new artwork.
Chapter digits inside source photo are omitted content difference; labels remain, new real actor is not asked to fake3/4 gestures.
Actual source hair-to-chin height306px corrected stock head scale0.334 versus previous0.423. Source long hair tips are not counted as face; visible chest preserved.

Visible pink rounded capsules are isolated per native frame; source hair-obscured upper arcs are unavailable, not fabricated; arbitrary new face shapes can expose a gap requiring independently redrawn approximate full ring.
Dim heading527..529 restores actual gray alpha rather than dropping faint entry; native black background makes foreground isolation possible.
F526/527 initial large iris: source camera crops torso, so chest below stockY1200 is vertically fitted to native inner circle floor; head/hair unchanged and original RGB kept, no hands invented.
原真实女士、手势数字3/4、键盘桌面与新真人/植物不同；画面中的真实数字手牌与头饰未合成到新演员身上。
526/527大圈入场下胸口纵向fit用于适配原生可见胸口范围，不恢复原人物不可拍到的姿势。
源长发遮掉的部分粉色虚线不可见，替换短发后上弧可能有少量缺口；完整可编辑虚线参数为8px圆头/15px直段/41px周期，隐藏相位仍需另审。
578原片为旋转动感模糊，新片用近似Gaussian10px并按原时间返小圆，运动方向残差明确。
固定漫画贴纸与原中文弧标题为私有原生字形，源字体工程未知，任意改字不继承同等精度。
